messages.text:
I turned on reduced motion on my computer, but the cards and the win banner still animate. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Fixed reduced motion for the cards and win banner. Card border transitions and the victory pulse now stop when the system requests reduced motion; normal animations remain unchanged.

Validation: the build and all 138 unit tests passed. Both motion browser tests passed. The full browser suite passed 75 checks, with one face-art check timing out; that check passed when rerun on its own.
